ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark-grey/black) base surface with approximately 12-15% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular spots distributed across central regions of both lobes; dense high-intensity clusters concentrated along the lateral leading edges due to calcified colonization.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary with jagged pixel transitions ranging from 5-20 pixels in amplitude across the entire visible trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the submerged central axis, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete white circular pixel clusters, particularly concentrated in the medial-lower quadrant of the left lobe and lower-center of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal high-contrast white linear disruptions visible on both lobes, with a prominent parallel set (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-relief, irregular-textured calcified clusters (barnacles) along both leading edges; large pendulous biological mass attached to the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant protrusion of stalked organisms extending past the geometric tip of the right fluke lobe.
